guest.description: Discover Cadéoly. To join a real list, open the link shared by your friend or relative.

tutorial.welcomeDescription: Keep your wishes in one place and find gifts your loved ones will enjoy. Shall we show you around?
tutorial.listDescription: A birthday, Christmas or a little wish? Name your list and add gift ideas with a link, a photo or a price.
tutorial.shareDescription: Invite your loved ones to your family space or share your list’s link directly. Everyone can discover your wishes.
tutorial.reserveTitle: Reserve a gift, keep the surprise
tutorial.reserveDescription: Browse your loved ones’ lists and reserve what you want to give. Other participants can avoid duplicates without spoiling the surprise for the recipient.
